|rulings=* Cannot cancel an Immediate Effect, Mobile Effect, or Starting Effect.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Alter%20%28Coruscant%29%20%28V%29 Scomp: Alter (Coruscant) (V)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Can be played as a top-level action.
* Can be played as a response to the attempted deployment of an Effect, Political Effect, or Utinni Effect. If successful, the target has no result.
* 'Immune to opponent's Objective' only works while initiating/playing it.
* It is protected from (for example) both sides of [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe{{!}}Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]].
* It is not protected from (for example) [[Invasion / In Complete Control{{!}}In Complete Control]] or [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal{{!}}I Will Make It Legal]].
* 'Immune to opponent's Objective' does ''not'' permit [[Alter]] to target [[Scum And Villainy]] against the 7-side of [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration{{!}}Carbon Chamber Testing]].
